**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is interested in theater and has been taking acting classes.

  1. "A Raisin in the Sun" by Lorraine Hansberry

  4. "The Flick" by Annie Baker
  5. "The Humans" by Stephen Karam
  6. "The Effect of Gamma Rays on Man-in-the-Moon Marigolds" by Paul Zindel
  7. "The Zoo Story" by Edward Albee
  8. "The Bear" by Anton Chekhov
- [PREFERENCE] The user is particularly interested in plays with strong ensemble casts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided statistics about the representation of women in the theater industry, including:
  - Women make up only 22% of playwrights, 18% of directors, and 12% of artistic directors in the American theater industry (2020 report by the League of Professional Theatre Women).
  - Only 28% of produced plays were written by women, and only 12% were written by women of color (2019 study by the Dramatists Guild of America).
